description: This file declares utility functions for processing association frames within the SON (Self-Organizing Networks) component of prplMesh. It provides methods to extract station capabilities from association request frames, including parsing specific fields and setting default management parameters.

classes.name: assoc_frame_utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse association request frames and derive station capabilities, including default settings based on supported rates.

methods.name: get_station_capabilities_from_assoc_frame
methods.description: Extracts station capabilities from a provided association request frame object. Parses the frame to populate the station capabilities structure.

methods.name: bool get_station_capabilities_from_assoc_field(const T & source,beerocks::message::sRadioCapabilities & result)
methods.description: Template method to parse specific fields from the association request data to fill station capabilities. It returns false by default for unsupported types.

methods.name: get_default_mcs_from_supported_rates
methods.description: Determines default MCS index and short GI flag based on supported rates provided by the station.
